script_text: Mercury squares Pluto today — your entire reality shifts dramatically in ways you didn't anticipate this week. Early Monday through Wednesday, Mars trines Uranus in your 11th House of community, energizing friendships and creative collaborations. Air energy fuels sudden inspiration, making Tuesday ideal for meaningful connection and conversation. Thursday shifts everything when Venus enters your 2nd House, aligning love and money in one powerful transit. Jupiter sextiles your natal Sun in the 10th House Friday, opening an unexpected career opportunity. The weekend pulls you toward family comfort and emotional grounding as the Moon glides into Cancer. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters the 2nd House, unlocking new income streams. Avoid any major purchases Monday when Mars clashes with lunar nodes in your 9th House. Ground any career impulses into a written plan before acting on Uranus's restless and fast energy. Follow for daily updates.
